content_blocks.label: clause_1._Notice_of_Default
content_blocks.text: You are hereby notified that you are in default of the lease agreement due to non-payment of rent as of June 1, 2024.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Deadline_to_Cure
content_blocks.text: You have thirty (30) days from the date of this Notice to cure the default and reinstate your tenancy.

content_blocks.label: notary_note
content_blocks.text: Sworn before me this 10th day of June 2024.
